source_read: https://app.served-app.com/website/dishoom (the page's four restaurant tabs ALL DAY, BREAKFAST, KIDS, DRINKS, every dish expanded) opened in a second, separate Chromium session at 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC at desktop width, 3 minutes after the script's own capture (2026-10-10 23:57 UTC, sha256 of capture.json c2ee4a1c966cf26718ebdd5f378ac6104a0cc1ce6bb586e4c073b405ac6b46eb); robots.txt of app.served-app.com is 'User-agent: *' 'Allow: /'
not_verifiable: Whether a dish with a Vegetarian/Vegan mark and no allergen lines (Kachumber, rice, sodas, juices) is truly allergen-free: the page shows only what applies, so 'none marked' is read as none of the 14. Two dishes with neither a mark nor an allergen line (Four rashers of bacon, Kids - tomato jam mayo) were left out for that reason. Nothing could be compared on the delivery menus, which were not read.
notes: Calories-only chain with complete allergens. A different method from the script (which reads each dish card's DOM nodes in a 430 px mobile layout): the whole page text of each tab in a fresh desktop session, split into dish blocks at the upper-case dish names by an independent parser, compared with the written items.csv and allergens.csv: all 201 published items matched on kcal and on the full Contains and May Contain sets (the 2 apparent mismatches, Fruit & Yoghurt 181 and the kids' 140, are the adult and kids' portions the verifier's name matching merged; both rows are right). The page lists 312 dishes on these 4 tabs (98 + 41 + 20 + 153), 201 published; 82 print no calories, 8 print half and full figures, 2 are one restaurant's only, 2 have no allergen record, 4 share a name with conflicting figures or allergens, 1 is per 100 ml; the other 12 are repeat listings of a dish already published from another section. marked_ok: Pallonji's Ice Cream Soda has 'Ice Cream' in its name but the page marks it Vegan with no allergens (audit medium flag name-implies-milk): kept as printed.
